title: Raceland bands and joining Billy Mack's show for Chicago
summary: He played with Paul Rozier and other local leaders, then joined Billy Mack's show in New Orleans; trombonist Wilbur Parrish and pianist Henry Brown were in the band.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Raceland, Louisiana, yeah. And so, a fellow by the name of Paul Rozier, like eight miles from my home, he picked up on me and brought me in his band. He had a band there, and I used to play with him all the time. Another fellow named Mike Taylor, one mile from there. And Nick's a fellow from here. Not from here. He's from Raceland, but he's an older man to me named Bo Bo. Used to be a tuba player way back there with Buddy Bowling. And he picked me up in Brompton, New Orleans, one time. And I come in and played a while, but I went back home again. I was very young then. And stuff like stuff stuff like stuff So, you know, I've heard it did now, but I know I'm explaining everything just how it was. So, when I first got away from that fellow by the name of Billy Mack, they had a shooter called the Miramack Makers. And when he got to New Orleans, he didn't have no trumpet player, so he asked me to play the show with him. So I played the show down with him, and from then on he asked me to go to Chicago.
Who else was in the band when you went up? Who else played in that band with you?
Well, they had a fellow named Wilbur Parrish, trombone, and a fellow named Brown, Henry Brown on piano. And, I'm trying to get back on it now, I can't.
Where'd they come from? They weren't from New Orleans then?

Well, Parrish, fellow, he's from, I think of Georgia. And they had a fellow from Mississippi, he's named Jackson. He played in the band. Old, there was fellows that I kind of slipped my remembrance now, but I, you know. Jackson, what did you do? Well, none of them was from New Orleans, not them.
That piano player, Henry Brown? Henry Brown.
Do you know where he came from?
No. What type of music did you play in the show, all sorts of?
